point: 把经典基于计数的探索推广到高维/连续空间,做法是先把状态映射成哈希码再计数
quote_en: a simple generalization of the classic count-based approach can reach near state-of-the-art performance on various high-dimensional and/or continuous deep RL benchmarks

point: 状态被映射成哈希码,用哈希表统计每个码出现的次数
quote_en: States are mapped to hash codes, which allows to count their occurrences with a hash table

point: 用这些计数按经典计数探索理论算出奖励加成
quote_en: These counts are then used to compute a reward bonus according to the classic count-based exploration theory

point: 简单哈希函数在许多有挑战的任务上就能取得意外地好的结果
quote_en: We find that simple hash functions can achieve surprisingly good results on many challenging tasks

point: 领域相关的学习型哈希码可进一步改善结果
quote_en: Furthermore, we show that a domain-dependent learned hash code may further improve these results

point: 分析揭示好哈希函数的两个关键:合适的粒度,以及编码与解MDP相关的信息
quote_en: Detailed analysis reveals important aspects of a good hash function: 1) having appropriate granularity and 2) encoding information relevant to solving the MDP

point: 训练时用 r+r+ 的奖励,评估时只看不含加成的奖励之和
quote_en: The agent is trained with rewards (r + r+), while performance is evaluated as the sum of rewards without bonuses

point: 每遇到一个状态 st 就把其哈希码计数加一
quote_en: For every state st encountered at time step t, n(φ(st)) is increased by one

point: 用 SimHash 这种计算高效的 LSH,按角度距离衡量相似度
quote_en: A computationally efficient type of LSH is SimHash [6], which measures similarity by angular distance

point: k 控制粒度:越大碰撞越少、越能区分状态
quote_en: The value for k controls the granularity: higher values lead to fewer collisions and are thus more able to distinguish states

point: 本方法用状态计数 n(s) 而非状态-动作计数 n(s,a),是对 MBIE-EB 的偏离
quote_en: Note that our approach is a departure from count-based exploration methods such as MBIE-EB since we use a state-space count n(s) rather than a state-action count n(s, a)

point: 实验过状态-动作计数,但没看到比状态计数有显著性能提升
quote_en: State-action counts n(s, a) are investigated in the Supplementary Material, but no significant performance gains over state counting could be witnessed

point: 对图像观测改用自编码器在隐层学有意义的哈希码,作为更高级的 LSH
quote_en: we propose to use an autoencoder (AE) to learn meaningful hash codes in one of its hidden layers as a more advanced LSH method

point: AE损失=负对数似然项+一个把二值码层逼向0/1的项(系数λ)
quote_en: This objective function consists of a negative log-likelihood term and a term that pressures the binary code layer to take on binary values, scaled by

point: 所有实验都用 TRPO 作为RL算法,因为它能处理离散与连续动作空间
quote_en: Trust Region Policy Optimization (TRPO, [30]) is chosen as the RL algorithm for all experiments, because it can handle both discrete and continuous action spaces

point: 在所有连续控制环境上带哈希计数探索都能到达目标(非零回报),而基线TRPO高斯噪声完全失败
quote_en: Using count-based exploration with hashing is capable of reaching the goal in all environments (which corresponds to a nonzero return), while baseline TRPO with Gaussia n control noise fails completely

point: SimHash 在 HalfCheetah 上拿到稀疏奖励,但不如 VIME
quote_en: Although TRPO-SimHash picks up the sparse reward on HalfCheetah, it does not perform as well as VIME

point: SimHash 在 MountainCar 与 VIME 相当,在 SwimmerGather 上超过 VIME
quote_en: the performance of SimHash is comparable with VIME on MountainCar, while it outperforms VIME on SwimmerGather

point: Atari选了六个长horizon、需大量探索的游戏:Freeway/Frostbite/Gravitar/Montezuma/Solaris/Venture
quote_en: six games are selected featuring long horizons while requiring significant exploration: Freeway, Frostbite, Gravitar, Montezuma's Revenge, Solaris, and Venture

point: 训500迭代、每迭代0.1M步(对应0.4M帧),计数算法只看最新一帧
quote_en: The agent is trained for 500 iterations in all experiments, with each iteration consisting of 0.1 M steps (the TRPO batch size, corresponds to 0.4 M frames)

point: Atari结果是50M时间步后的平均总回报
quote_en: Atari 2600: average total reward after training for 50 M time steps

point: TRPO-pixel-SimHash已大幅超过基线,并在Frostbite上打破此前最好结果
quote_en: TRPO-pixel-SimHash already outperforms the baseline by a large margin and beats the previous best result on Frostbite

point: TRPO-BASS-SimHash在Montezuma和Venture上比pixel版显著改善,更好地捕捉物体位置
quote_en: TRPO-BASS-SimHash achieves significant improvement over TRPO-pixel-SimHash on Montezuma's Revenge and Venture, where it captures object locations better than other methods

point: TRPO-AE-SimHash在Freeway/Frostbite/Solaris上接近SOTA
quote_en: TRPO-AE-SimHash achieves near state-of-the-art performance on Freeway, Frostbite and Solaris

point: BASS是为Atari图像手工设计的特征变换
quote_en: BASS is a hand-designed feature transformation for images in Atari 2600 games

point: 用BASS或AE学习哈希码在Gravitar/Montezuma/Venture上带来大得多的性能
quote_en: preprocessing images with BASS or using a learned hash code through the AE leads to much better performance on Gravitar, Montezuma's Revenge and Venture

point: 未在所有游戏达到SOTA的原因:TRPO不复用off-policy经验,处理极稀疏奖励效率较低
quote_en: A reason why our proposed method does not achieve state-of-the-art performance on all games is that TRPO does not reuse off-policy experience, in contrast to DQN-based algorithms

point: 佐证:同样的探索加成下,on-policy的A3C+得分远低于off-policy的DQN
quote_en: A3C+ (an on-policy algorithm) scores much lower than DQN (an off-policy algorithm), while using the exact same exploration bonus

point: k=16只有65536个码,不足以区分语义不同的状态,导致更差的性能
quote_en: k = 16 only corresponds to 65536 distinct hash codes, which is insufficient to distinguish between semantically distinct states and hence leads to worse performance

point: k=512在Frostbite上倾向捕捉琐碎图像细节,让agent以为每个状态都新、都值得探索
quote_en: k = 512 tends to capture trivial image details in Frostbite, leading the agent to believe that every state is new and equally worth exploring

point: 粒度增大时应同时调低奖励系数
quote_en: it is important to lower the bonus coefficient as granularity is increased

point: Montezuma上最佳SmartHash agent训练1000迭代(1000M步)、grid size s=10,拿到6600总回报
quote_en: the best agent is able to obtain 6600 total rewards after training for 1000 iterations (1000 M time steps), with a grid size s = 10

point: 把敌人位置纳入SmartHash反而让平均分掉到1672;完全忽略敌人位置则达到5661
quote_en: by ignoring enemy locations altogether, the agent achieves a much higher score (5661)

point: agent会错误地'喜欢'远观敌人运动(因不断观察到新状态)而忘了进别的房间
quote_en: the agent also erroneously "enjoys" watching enemy motions at distance (since new states are constantly observed) and "forgets" that his main objective is to enter other rooms

point: 结论:经哈希推广经典计数能在连续/高维MDP上提供合适的探索信号,达到接近SOTA
quote_en: a generalization of classical counting techniques through hashing is able to provide an appropriate signal for exploration, even in continuous and/or high-dimensional MDPs
